newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ROLLS WINS S.AFRICAN LOADER CONTRACT.
newsitem.headline: ROLLS WINS S.AFRICAN LOADER CONTRACT.

text.p: Britain's Rolls Royce Plc said on Monday that it had sealed a contract worth 37 million rand to supply materials handling equipment to the world's biggest coal terminal of Richards Bay in South Africa.
The deal will see the firm's France-based Caillard unit supply an 11,000 tonne continuous ship loader which will be commissioned at the end of 1998.

"We have a number of other contracts in operation in South Africa and we are setting up a permanent base in Johannesburg to manage these and future projects," said Kernal Bayram, Caillard managing director.
Caillard recently completed the world's largest port refurbishment in Durban and is also upgrading cranes in Cape Town and Port Elizabeth.
